values.meaning: maximum bonus attack speed (at 70%+ missing health) by champion level
values.binNote: Bin gives this as byLevel(0.5..1); the wiki's closed-form formula reproduces the same 50%->100% range across levels 1-18.

values.meaning: maximum life steal (at 70%+ missing health) by champion level
values.binNote: Bin gives this as byLevel(0.08..0.25); the wiki's closed-form formula reproduces the same 8%->25% range across levels 1-18.

values.meaning: fraction of the max attack speed/life steal granted per point of missing health (scales to 100% of max at 70% missing health)
values.quote: 1% per 0.7% '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 70% '''missing''' health.''
values.binNote: Bin exposes OlafBerzerkerRage.AttackSpeedPerMissingHPPerc=0.009 and MaxStatsThreshold=0.3, but neither maps cleanly to the wiki's stated '1% per 0.7% missing health, capped at 70% missing' scaling curve (1/0.7=1.42857, not 0.009); MaxStatsThreshold=0.3 is consistent with the 70%-missing cap (1-0.3=0.7) but AttackSpeedPerMissingHPPerc's exact role is unclear, flagged as a disagreement/uncertainty rather than resolved by guessing.

mechanics.claim: Olaf passively gains bonus attack speed and life steal that scale with his missing health, reaching their level-based maximum at 70% missing health.
mechanics.quote: gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}
